summary: Most modules moved from ansible/ansible into collections in Ansible 2.10; ansible-core (briefly ansible-base) contains only basic features, while collections are maintained by the Ansible team, community or partners.
questions: Why are most modules no longer in ansible-core?
When did Ansible start using collections?
What is the difference between ansible-core and collections?

answer_card.title: Where did all the modules go?
answer_card.answer_md: Since **Ansible 2.10**, most modules live in **collections** (support began in 2.9). The ansible/ansible repo is now **ansible-core** (briefly ansible-base in 2.10) with only core features and `ansible.builtin` content. Install collections with `ansible-galaxy collection install <ns.name>`, or install the full `ansible` package, which bundles many of them.
